title: Prolonged corticosteroid therapy in scheduled cardiac surgery in intermediate/high-risk patients: a prospective multicenter randomized controlled double-blind placebo-controlled study
official: Prolonged corticosteroid therapy in scheduled cardiac surgery in intermediate/high-risk patients: a prospective multicenter randomized controlled double-blind placebo-controlled study
summary: Main objective: demonstrate the efficacy of prolonged corticosteroid therapy for 5 days (Hydrocortisone + Fludrocortisone) versus placebo in intermediate/high-risk patients undergoing scheduled cardiac surgery.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age > 18 years.
2. Patient at intermediate/high risk (Euroscore II>4%)
3. Patient admitted for scheduled cardiac surgery
4. Extracorporeal circulation
5. signed informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Endocarditis
2. End-stage renal failure with long-term dialysis
3. - Contraindications to the administration of hydrocortisone and/or fludrocortisone according to the drugs' prescribing information
4. Pregnant or breast-feeding women
5. Patients under guardianship, curatorship or safeguard of justice
6. Beating heart surgery
7. Heart transplantation or long-term ventricular assistance
8. Emergency surgery: aortic dissection, emergency coronary artery bypass surgery
9. Failed exit from bypass with need for short-acting assistance (counterpulsation balloon, ECMO)
10. Hypothermic surgery
11. Previous cardiac surgery
12. Patient on long-term corticosteroid therapy
13. Autoimmune or chronic inflammatory disease.
